svg.title: Local browser adapter results and required deployment matrix
svg.desc: On the already staged public 1.1.54-beta.12 fixture, six scenarios passed in each of Chromium, Firefox and WebKit on macOS. These eighteen local scenario executions do not constitute hosted release qualification. Beta requires five targets and stable staging requires thirty-five targets.

g.text: Six real scenarios in each engine
macOS · Playwright 1.64.0 · staged public player 1.1.54-beta.12 · 15 October 2026
Deployment policy is a separate requirement
Beta: 5 hosted targets · Stable staging: 35 hosted targets · Every selected target must pass.
Snapshot of adapter verification, not a production deployment or a completed hosted release qualification.
